limitations: variants are sampled (3 per row per perturbation), not exhaustive
typos/casing do not touch Devanagari, so pure-Hindi rows are mostly 'not effective' for them
B01-B06 (banned-phrase statements) were added after the first run to give directional_replace_banned usable power (only 1 final_test row contains a banned phrase)
hand-written expectations marked judgement are opinions, reported separately from strict/documented ones
directional/invariance checks compare the model with itself, not with gold labels
